outcome: Prevalence of abnormal SBP (pre-hypertension or hypertension)
cohort: 632 offspring from a birth cohort in Chiang Mai, Thailand, born in 1989-1990
finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with increased blood pressure in young adulthood.
mod_finding: This study found an association between cesarean section delivery and increased blood pressure in young adulthood compared to vaginal birth.
